items.headline: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI progress acceleration threshold back in July
items.summary: An independent METR evaluation estimates Anthropic's research productivity roughly doubled since October 2025, with about 80% from AI-assisted research. Anthropic's S-1 called crossing the 2x threshold plausible but publicly reported the factor below 2.
items.why: This is the first time an independent evaluator has found evidence a frontier lab may have triggered its own responsible-scaling safeguard. The finding arrives weeks before Anthropic's planned IPO, raising questions about how acceleration risks are measured and disclosed.

items.headline: Bloomberg: OpenAI raises $11B at a $1.25T valuation, well below its original $30B target
items.summary: The first tranche includes Coatue, T. Rowe Price, SoftBank, Sequoia, Founders Fund and a16z. The round may reach $20B but falls short of the $30B OpenAI sought at $1.4T before an AI-sector selloff.

items.headline: OpenAI partners with security firm Hacktron to find vulnerabilities across its AI systems
items.summary: Hacktron researchers will jointly pick high-priority areas with OpenAI engineers, focusing on how OpenAI's systems interact with third-party services. OpenAI is also expanding Hacktron's access to frontier models through Daybreak Red.

items.headline: Nine AI agents fail expert-level autonomous research benchmark from US national labs
items.summary: The 'Into the Unknown' benchmark asked agents to write follow-up studies from existing papers. Of 135 submissions, 114 failed integrity checks. GPT-6 Astra scored best overall, followed by Claude Opus 5.5.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO valuation slides toward $1.1T as enterprise AI spending growth stalls
items.summary: Bloomberg reports investors now target $1.1-1.3T for Anthropic, down from $2T a month ago. Ramp data shows enterprise token spending grew just 1.5% in August-September after a 42% July spike as price cuts compress revenue.
